'''Cheg''' was a noisy, and occasionally somewhat violent, tabletop game. In a typical game of Cheg, two players competed against each other for control of a small puck, using their knuckles to strike and propel the puck across the tabletop<ref name="Bloodlines" /> and into a goal in order to score points.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Players commonly shoulder-charged nearby opponents during the course of the game as part of their over all effort to either gain or keep control of the puck.<ref name="Bloodlines" />

Across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] such as [[Zerria's Bar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drall (planet)|Drall]] hosted tables on which to play Cheg. The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] [[Novoc Vevut]] and [[Ghes Orade]] were veteran Cheg players, and elected to teach the game to [[Mirta Gev]] following a meeting with the reigning [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], at Zerria's Bar. Gev learned the rules quickly, and played a spirited match against Orade.<ref name="Bloodlines" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cheg was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' novel [[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines|''Bloodlines'']], written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[August 29]], [[2006]].<ref name="Bloodlines" /> Cheg was later given an informational entry in the [[2008]] reference guide ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="TCSWE" />

The manner in which the game of Cheg is described, both in ''Bloodlines'' as well as ''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia'', strongly resembles the real-world tabletop game of [[Wikipedia:Air hockey|air hockey]].
